lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Minnesota Vikings −1.0 with a fair total of 46.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Minnesota Vikings pass offence vs Buffalo Bills pass defence, which sits −0.137 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Buffalo Bills and Minnesota Vikings have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
